expected_findings.description: The fallback return statement duplicates the Path.cwd() expression from the start of the function, causing Path.cwd() to be called twice when start is None instead of once.
The test exercises the same no-.imp-found path as test_returns_cwd_when_no_imp_dir and does not meaningfully test the root-stopping logic.
The function's resolve() call transparently resolves symlinked start paths, but the docstring claims 'returns start unchanged', creating a misleading discrepancy.
The original explanatory comment about the function's purpose was removed; a comment like 'Plan 3: walk-up discovery; Task 7 adds signal handler' would help future implementers.
